title: Name the `identity` field in the CHANGELOG and the `task list --across-refs` help, and say a consumer must read it to detect collisions (opum-doc 565 release condition)
description:
Release condition set by opum-doc's ruling on QCLI-432 (relayed by the team-lead as opum-doc 565 = A, FINAL): the per-entry `identity: "task" | "collision" | "unresolved"` on `task list --across-refs` is final, and before the next lore+quest PAIR release quest-cli's CHANGELOG and the `task list --across-refs` help must NAME the field AND say that a consumer must read it to detect collisions.

WHAT EXISTS vs THE GAP. The across-refs help already DESCRIBES `identity` (task = one createdAt; collision = two or more distinct createdAt, different records sharing an id; unresolved = a state carries no createdAt, so the pair cannot be compared) and says `identity` is not `conflict` (conflict = status divergence WITHIN one task). It does NOT say a consumer MUST read `identity` to detect a collision. The CHANGELOG names the field nowhere.

SCOPE: documentation only -- the CHANGELOG (Unreleased) and the across-refs help text. No behaviour change, no schema change. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED, and the worker implements it directly through the normal gates (branch, PR, review, land).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CHANGELOG names the per-entry `identity` field of `task list --across-refs` and states that a consumer must read it to detect a genuine id collision
The `task list --across-refs` help names `identity` and states that a consumer must read it to detect a genuine id collision, with no behaviour change (`bun run check` exits 0)

finalSummary: QCLI-478, the opum-doc 565 (DEC-172 (4u)) release condition carried on QCLI-432 final identity shape: the CHANGELOG (Unreleased, Added) and the task list --across-refs help now NAME the per-entry identity field and state that a consumer MUST read it to detect a genuine id collision, because conflict alone reports only status divergence within one task. Documentation only -- no behaviour change, no schema change; bun run check exits 0. Delivered on branch qcli-478-identity-docs with its record in the same PR, landing on dev.
